disposition_reason: 30-day avian dietary toxicity study comparing soluble sodium molybdate and insoluble molybdenum disulfide; NOAEC/LOAEC and tissue accumulation in quail, not food or human data.

study.method: ICP-MS for Mo and Cu in feed and tissues
lod: Basal feed Mo not detectable at LOQ 5.40 ppm; well water Mo not detected at LOQ 0.0400 ppm (p. 293)

unresolved: Methods text lists the middle MoS2 dose as 3000 in one sentence and 2000 elsewhere; Table 1 reports 2000.
regulatory_or_exposure: Sodium molybdate: NOAEC 1200 mg Mo/kg feed (134 mg/kg bw/day); LOAEC 2000 mg Mo/kg feed (253 mg/kg bw/day) in northern bobwhite (p. 300)
Molybdenum disulfide: NOAEC at highest dose 5000 mg Mo/kg feed (about 545 mg/kg bw/day) (p. 300)
non_numeric_findings: Long-bone molybdenum day 30: control 551.9 ng/g dw; 3000 mg/kg sodium molybdate 57,750 ng/g; 5000 mg/kg molybdenum disulfide 1278 ng/g (Table 3, p. 298)
